name: lathe
description: A software factory for Claude Code: one plugin with a working agreement and enforced gates, a code graph and evidence ledger, an epic writer, and one-command onboarding for a brownfield repository.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: Init, onboard, audit, ticket, tests, implement, verify, ship and orchestrate, with hooks that enforce scope, secrets, route auth, module state, test quality and verify-before-commit as a ratchet over today's debt; a code graph and evidence ledger over MCP that start without a database; an epic writer. The graph needs uv and a Postgres.
